To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
LSA is a powerful, general-purpose, and robust tool for representing the meaning of words, passages, and essays.

the latent semantic structure of the language as represented by a large corpus of English text is a powerful and general tool for representing the knowledge of the English language, and that this tool can be used to predict and explain a wide range of human performance on a variety of tasks that involve language.
LSA is a useful and practical tool for estimating the coherence of text, the quality of student essays, and the learnability of texts by individuals.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of methods for extracting and representing contextual meaning from text.
the development of a theory and method of knowledge representation that is grounded in human language and that is useful in the analysis and understanding of human language and thought.
understanding how people understand text.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
LSA provides a good model of human semantic memory.
LSA's representation of meaning is not only a good approximation to human semantic knowledge but also a very good one.
, in the aggregate, LSA is a highly accurate and efficient representation of knowledge.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, for a wide variety of human judgments and tasks, the LSA scores are highly correlated with human judgments and performance.
LSA's word word and passage passage similarity estimates reflect a substantial amount of knowledge about word meaning and the structure of text.
LSA is a theory of meaning and a method of representing meaning in a way that is computationally tractable and that is useful for a wide range of applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the semantic structure of language is a complex phenomenon that is only partially captured by the explicit semantic relations in a lexicon and by explicit syntactic and semantic rules of grammar.
LSA can be used to assess the coherence, learnability, and quality of written passages.
LSA is a useful and practical tool for understanding how people learn and for improving instruction and assessment.
